pendingExplanation: These requests stay on this computer. Reviewing does not apply withdrawals, discounts, refunds or payments to the system.
needCash: Open a register to record these operations.
discountHelp: Request a discount with a reason. Prices change only with valid integration and authorization.
localReview: Local review records the supervisor decision; it does not replace server authorization.
returnHelp: Select a recorded sale. Requesting a return does not delete the sale, restore stock or move money.
partial: Incomplete query. Unknown values do not mean zero.
confirmCancel: Request cancellation of this sale? The original record will be retained.
confirmWithdraw: Withdraw this request? History will be retained.
bagHelp: The code identifies the bag record. Confirm sealing, handover, receipt and recount. This record is not yet sent to the server.
notDrawerBalance: This total is not the drawer balance: opening cash and official movements missing from this query are excluded.
connectionsHelp: Connect services and equipment in settings. No item is marked connected without confirmation.
cardsHelp: Provider authorization, queries, reversal and settlement.
fiscalHelp: Identification, issuance, rejection, contingency and printing.
clubHelp: Registration, consent, balance and points per sale.
drawerHelp: Authorized opening only after sale confirmation.
printerHelp: Printing receipts and fiscal documents on the device.
mobileCameraHelp: Authorized pairing and secure transfer of checking data.
backupHelp: Integrated backup and verified restoration of all records.
splitHelp: Compose this purchase’s payments. The amounts must match exactly.
splitUnavailable: This installation only completes cash payments. Save this composition as preparation, without charging or confirming a sale.
clearComposition: Discard this composition and return to a single method? No payment will be made.
cashReceivedRequired: For cash portions, also enter the amount tendered in the cash received field.
permission: Your profile cannot perform this action.
unbalanced: Payments must add up to the sale total.
duplicate: An active request already exists for this operation.
returnExceeded: Quantity exceeds the amount available for return.
bagOpen: A bag already exists for this closing.
differentReviewer: Another authorized person must perform this check.
storageError: Cannot access local records. Preserve the data.
conflict: Another window changed the records. Reload before continuing.
sourceError: Could not retrieve sales or receipt.
discountBlocking: A discount request exists for this cart. Resolve or withdraw it before selling at full price.
countRequired: Confirm the cash count before recording the bag.
compositionSaved: Composition saved locally without confirming a sale or charge.
suspendHelp: Suspending stores the cart locally without selling or reserving stock. Customer CPF will be requested again when resumed.
noSuspended: No suspended sales in this register.
resumeConfirm: Resume with currently loaded products and prices? Check history before reopening an already resumed draft.
resumedHelp: Cart resumed with current prices. Check discounts and customer identification.
catalogRefresh: Load this sale’s products in the catalog before resuming. The draft was retained.
historyWindow: Showing recent records. Download the files for full history.
